Extension Manifest ​

Every extension requires an extension.json manifest file.

Full Schema ​

json
{
  "name": "my-extension",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "description": "What your extension does (max 500 chars)",
  "author": "Your Name",
  "license": "MIT",
  "main": "index.js",
  "hooks": [
    "on:app:ready",
    "after:share:create",
    "after:download:complete"
  ],
  "permissions": [
    "config:read",
    "config:write",
    "shares:read",
    "notifications"
  ],
  "config": {
    "webhookUrl": {
      "type": "string",
      "default": "",
      "description": "Webhook URL for notifications"
    },
    "enabled": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "default": true,
      "description": "Enable notifications"
    }
  },
  "tier": "free",
  "minAppVersion": "0.5.0"
}

Required Fields ​

FieldTypeDescription
namestring1-50 chars, alphanumeric with ., -, _
versionstringSemver (e.g., 1.0.0)
descriptionstringMax 500 characters
authorstringAuthor name
licensestringLicense identifier (e.g., MIT)
mainstringEntry point file (must be .js, no path traversal)

Optional Fields ​

FieldTypeDefaultDescription
hooksstring[][]Events to subscribe to (max 20)
permissionsstring[][]Required permissions (max 10)
configobject{}User-configurable settings
tierstring"free""free", "pro", or "enterprise"
minAppVersionstring—Minimum Palexplorer version
signerPublicKeystring—Ed25519 public key of the signer

Config Schema ​

Each config key supports:

PropertyTypeDescription
typestring"boolean", "string", "number", "array"
defaultanyDefault value
descriptionstringUser-visible description

Users configure values with:

bash
pal ext config my-extension webhookUrl "https://..."

Validation Rules ​

  • name: 1-50 chars, pattern: /^[a-zA-Z0-9._-]+$/
  • version: Valid semver
  • main: Must end in .js, no .. or / traversal
  • permissions: Max 10, must be from valid set
  • hooks: Max 20, must be from valid set
  • description: Max 500 characters
